I’m taking a look at this.

From an initial read, it seems `scalableTaskPoller.taskPollerType` is used by `pollerBalancer`, but the workflow pollers created in `newWorkflowTaskWorkerInternal` don’t appear to set it for sticky/non-sticky pollers. I’m tracing the initialization path now and can put up a PR if that ends up being the right fix.

I traced this to `newScalableTaskPoller`, which wasn't setting `scalableTaskPoller.taskPollerType`. I opened a PR wiring the workflow poller types through for mixed/non-sticky/sticky workflow pollers and added a small regression test.
